source.author: verg
source.text: Tu Maxumus ille es, unus qui nobis cunctando restituis rem.
source.text_original: Tu Maxumus ille es, / unus qui nobis cunctando restituis rem.
source.text_english: You are that Maximus, the one man who by delaying restores our fortunes to us.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Tu Maximus ille es, Unus, qui nobis scribendo restituis rem.
reuse.text_original: Tu Maximus ille es, Unus, qui nobis scribendo restituis rem.
reuse.text_english: You are that Maximus, the one and only, who by writing restores the matter to us.
